name: Six-qubit graph state stabilizer expectations in Qiskit
task_prompt: Build the 6-qubit graph state for edges [(0, 1), (0, 2), (1, 3), (2, 4), (3, 5), (4, 5)]: apply H to every qubit and CZ on every edge. For each vertex v, construct K_v = X_v times Z on its neighbors using SparsePauliOp.from_sparse_list so qubit indexing is unambiguous, evaluate all stabilizers with StatevectorEstimator, print them, and assert every expectation is +1 within 1e-12. Provide only complete executable Python code. Do not use remote services. Seed random generators, print the requested quantities, and include robust self-tests rather than relying on visual inspection.
